selection_rule: 기능 합격 concept 중 actuator/fault/cleaning 부담이 가장 낮은 것

functional_evidence.return_to_active_cutter_region: 52 degree wedge terminates above rotor-swept shelf
functional_evidence.anti_ribbon: replaceable comb opening is narrower than 5 mm screen path
functional_evidence.anti_axial: 8 mm overlap replaceable labyrinth at both shaft ends
functional_evidence.no_dead_pocket: 55 degree drain floor and open sweep path
functional_evidence.cleaning: four captive M5 screen tray fasteners; withdraw on locked service side
functional_evidence.operator_guard: downward guarded service chute; rotor lockout required before access

trade.reason: ribbon bypass and axial migration unresolved
passes but adds jam/tach/drive failure and cleaning burden

trade.reason: selected: all functions with no added actuator
